_meta: G7.1 B5 AMMO TIERS (ARMY71, docs/G71_SCOPE.md B5; Last Protocol only per roster 5A Q1; Q5: mechanic + unlock/upgrade API now, LP keeps research_all so every tier starts unlocked at level 1 until H7 builds run progression). rules.g71_ammo drives sim/systems/ammo71.gd. Tier effects ride the existing rounds8 upgrade hook (shooter e.r8up multipliers on the weapon's ballistics8 round: pen / wound / kill / k / chem), so no ballistics8 edit is needed. Every number is PROVISIONAL.

g71_ammo._research_note: PROVISIONAL (Q5). true = every side starts with every tier unlocked at level 1 (LP research_all). false = locked until unlock(tier).
g71_ammo._level_note: PROVISIONAL. Upgrade level L scales each tier multiplier's distance from 1.0 by 1 + level_step x (L - 1).
g71_ammo._tiers_note: PROVISIONAL. mods = rounds8 upgrade multipliers (Ballistics8.round_for: pen, wound, kill, k; chem = penetration ignores velocity). stock = rounds per side at state creation (supply drops D2 add through Ammo71.add_stock). ignite_s = Parts71.ignite seconds on a hit (stops nanite regrowth). Costs / times are for H7 progression, unused now.
g71_ammo._class_note: PROVISIONAL. Weapon class -> tiers it may load (content weapon 'class'). A weapon with no rounds8 round (flame, melee, energy) has no tiers.
